description: Unit tests for the HttpRequestHeaders class, testing header manipulation functions such as setting, removing, merging, and parsing headers.

methods.name: HasHeader
methods.description: Tests if a header exists, case-insensitive.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets a header value.

methods.name: SetMultipleHeaders
methods.description: Sets multiple headers and verifies string output.

methods.name: SetHeaderTwice
methods.description: Sets the same header twice and checks output.

methods.name: SetHeaderTwiceCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Sets headers with different case and verifies case-insensitive behavior.

methods.name: SetHeaderTwiceSamePrefix
methods.description: Sets headers with similar prefixes and verifies output.

methods.name: SetEmptyHeader
methods.description: Sets a header with an empty value.

methods.name: SetHeaderIfMissing
methods.description: Sets a header only if missing.

methods.name: RemoveHeader
methods.description: Removes a header.

methods.name: RemoveHeaderMissingHeader
methods.description: Attempts to remove a non-existent header.

methods.name: RemoveHeaderCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Removes a header case-insensitively.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromString
methods.description: Adds a header from a string.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringNoLeadingWhitespace
methods.description: Adds a header from a string without leading whitespace.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringMoreLeadingWhitespace
methods.description: Adds a header with extra leading whitespace.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringTrailingWhitespace
methods.description: Adds a header with trailing whitespace.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringLeadingTrailingWhitespace
methods.description: Adds a header with leading and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringWithEmptyValue
methods.description: Adds a header with an empty value.

methods.name: AddHeaderFromStringWithWhitespaceValue
methods.description: Adds a header with whitespace as value.

methods.name: MergeFrom
methods.description: Merges headers from another HttpRequestHeaders object.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Copies headers from another HttpRequestHeaders object.
